title: Twins' matching nightmares in two states
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Twins' matching nightmares in two states, about late 1980s at Massachusetts and Vermont, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Charlie Foltz, who says he himself was part of a strange experience, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast about twin brothers, Jim and Jack Weiner. According to him, in the late 1980s, while Jim lived in Massachusetts and Jack lived in Vermont with his wife, both began having the very same nightmares at the same time. He tells it as a sign that the brothers shared a real experience, one he and others connect to being taken by non-human beings.
